algorithm.admission: keep whole CLAHE-only component when overlap with 1px-dilated evidence meets threshold
algorithm.evidence: independent hybrid-seeded source-colour/ridge local recovery additions
algorithm.proposal: CLAHE-Eynollah p0.50 minus full-page Eynollah p0.50

interpretation_guardrail: Accepted pieces remain optional proposal evidence. No policy is chosen by accepted-pixel count alone, and no proposal is merged into source truth.

observations: On acknowledgement-tight, conservative gating reduced 6,262 CLAHE-only pixels in 638 fragments to 4,077 pixels in 31 whole components and concentrated the remaining proposals on source-visible writing continuations.
On folded-write-to-you, conservative 0.25 retained 1,783 of 3,605 CLAHE-only pixels in 17 components; useful faint fragments remained, while many unsupported specks disappeared.

On enough-tight, conservative 0.25 reduced 7,051 pixels to 1,429 pixels in five components, but these were still dominated by stronger neighboring letters and did not reconstruct the nearly erased word middle.

The 0.10 versus 0.25 thresholds were identical on acknowledgement and nearly identical on folded writing because supported components had high overlap. The sweep does not justify optimizing a single overlap value globally.

selection_rule: Reuse the same three source bboxes frozen before crop inference; sweep two source-evidence profiles and two predeclared overlap gates.
